behaviors.name: Fall
behaviors.intent: Fall past the window, drifting, and start again at the top.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  move self by (sin(time + self.id) * 0.12 * dt, -0.32 * dt, 0)
  if self.position.y < 1.35 then
    self.position.y = 3.25
  end
end

behaviors.name: Dance
behaviors.intent: Flames lick up and down, never the same twice.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let s = 0.55 + sin(time * 9 + self.id * 1.7) * 0.12 + random() * 0.12
  self.scale = (0.3, s, 0.3)
end

behaviors.name: Choo
behaviors.intent: Go round and round the tree.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  rotate self by (0, -28 * dt, 0)
end

behaviors.name: Breathe
behaviors.intent: Sleep and breathe slowly.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let b = sin(time * 1.6) * 0.03
  self.scale = (0.62, 0.34 + b, 0.46 + b)
end

behaviors.name: Breathe
behaviors.intent: Snore gently.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  let b = sin(time * 1.2) * 0.035
  self.scale = (0.5 + b, 0.65, 0.42 + b)
end

behaviors.name: Flicker
behaviors.intent: The firelight breathes and flickers.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.light.intensity = 5 + sin(time * 7) * 0.6 + random() * 1.1
end

behaviors.name: Drift
behaviors.intent: A slow, dreamy drift around the room.
behaviors.source:
on tick
  self.position = (3.4 + sin(time * 0.15) * 0.5, 2.35 + sin(time * 0.2) * 0.1, 3.6)
  look self at (-1.2, 1.1, -1)
end
